title: Variations of colored multiset Eulerian polynomials and applications
summary: Deligeorgaki, Han and Solus introduced colored multiset Eulerian polynomials, derived a generating function identity which generalizes MacMahon's identity, proved their self-interlacing under suitable parameter conditions, and identified these polynomials as the h^*-polynomials of direct products of dilated lattice simplices.
